projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.shock_r: A Fulmini: a being of living energy held in a suit of rock. He fires blasts of it, shapes it into blades and shields, and his rock chunks can fly apart and slam back together. Very durable. Hidden: a mistransform finds him.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.shock_rock.rol: Energy tank: hard to hurt, fires bolts, forms a blade and a shield, and overloads to hit harder.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.shock_rock.pas: Rock Armour: very tough, hard to knock back, and shots hurt him a third less.
Energy constructs: a blade on his arm (G) and a shield in front of him (C).
Overload Mode (V): a third more damage while his Energy meter drains.
Fulmini Core: lightning heals him and fills his Energy.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.shock_rock.wea: Short Circuit: in water his Energy drains and Overload cuts out.
Heavy and slow: no fast movement but his Energy Dash (X).
Not on the dial until a mistransform (the 11th, 22nd, 33rd...) finds him.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.energy_b: A bolt of energy from your fist: 8.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.rapid_bo: Five bolts in half a second: 5 each.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.energy_b: A blade of energy forms on your arm for 10 s or 6 hits: your punches become slashes for 13, and they also cut whatever stands close beside the target (6).
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.rock_bur: Your rock armour flies apart and slams back together: 18 to everything within 6 blocks, thrown back, with a pulse of energy from your bared core.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.energy_d: A burst of energy drives you where you look. Whatever you pass through takes 6. No fall damage until you land.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.shield_c: 5 s of an energy shield in front of you: blows, shots and blasts from in front are stopped (shots are knocked back).
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.overload: Your energy burns brighter: your moves hit a third harder while your Energy drains (about 7 a second). Needs 25 Energy; press V again to end it. Energy refills 3 a second when you aren't overloaded.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.rock_fis: Stone knuckles: your punches hit for +6.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.rock_arm: Heavy armour, hard to knock back, and shots hurt you a third less.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.fulmini_: Lightning never hurts you: a strike heals 2 hearts and gives 30 Energy.
projecthero.omnitrix.shock_rock.short_ci: In water your Energy drains (4 a second) and Overload cuts out.
Not enough Energy (needs %s). It refills while you aren't overloaded.
Short circuit! Water puts your Overload out.
